name: Snow Crab Condition

creator.affiliation: NOAA AFSC Fisheries Behavioral Ecology Program
creator.name: Louise Copeman

description: Immature juvenile snow crab hepatopancreas samples collected for fatty acid analyses

variableMeasured.name: cruise
variableMeasured.description: Cruise ID for Bering Sea bottom trawl surveys. YYYY-01 indicates EBS surveys, YYYY-02 indicates NBS surveys. See RACEBASE or AKFIN for additional NOAA cruise metadata

variableMeasured.name: gis_station
variableMeasured.description: Alpha-numeric designation for the station established in the design of AFSC standardized surveys.

variableMeasured.name: area_swept
variableMeasured.description: Unit of effort for AFSC bottom trawl surveys: computed by distance towed*mean net width

variableMeasured.name: cpue
variableMeasured.description: Station-level snow crab density, calculated as CPUE

variableMeasured.name: vial_id
variableMeasured.description: Unique ID for hepatopancreas sample. AKK=Alaska Knight samples, V=Vesteraalen samples

variableMeasured.name: vessel
variableMeasured.description: ID number of the vessel used to collect data for that haul associated with vessel name.

variableMeasured.name: haul
variableMeasured.description: Uniquely identifies a sampling event (haul) within an AFSC cruise. It is a sequential number, in chronological order of occurrence.

variableMeasured.name: sex
variableMeasured.description: Sex of specimen sampled. 1=Male, 2-Female

variableMeasured.name: cw
variableMeasured.description: Carapace width of specimen sampled

variableMeasured.name: ch_cc
variableMeasured.description: Chela height (males) or clutch code (females) used to determine maturity. 0 clutch code for females signifies 000, or immature

variableMeasured.name: crab_wgt
variableMeasured.description: Whole crab weight of specimen sampled (prior to dissection). Only individuals with no missing limbs weighed

variableMeasured.name: hepatotray_wt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat

variableMeasured.name: hepato_wwt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of hepatopancreas

variableMeasured.name: hepato_dwt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of hepatopancreas after drying at 70C for 48hrs

variableMeasured.name: muscletray_wt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat

variableMeasured.name: muscle_wwt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of muscle tissue from 1st walking leg during dissection

variableMeasured.name: muscle_dwt
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: Total weight of aluminum weigh boat PLUS 1-2 grams of muscle tissue after drying at 70C for 48hrs

variableMeasured.name: process_date
variableMeasured.description: 2019 samples only: date of dissection at KFRC (crab frozen whole in 2019 and dissected post-freeze)

variableMeasured.name: notes
variableMeasured.description: Additional comments recorded during at-sea dissections

variableMeasured.name: maturity
variableMeasured.description: Maturity of specimen sampled. 0=Immature, 1=Mature

variableMeasured.name: mid_latitude
variableMeasured.description: Latitude of specimen collection. Designates latitude at start of haul for AFSC standardized surveys

variableMeasured.name: mid_longitude
variableMeasured.description: Longitude of specimen collection. Designates longititude at start of haul for AFSC standardized surveys

variableMeasured.name: bottom_depth
variableMeasured.description: Bottom depth at station for AFSC standardized surveys

variableMeasured.name: gear_temperature
variableMeasured.description: Bottom temperature at sampling station

variableMeasured.name: year
variableMeasured.description: Year of specimen collection

variableMeasured.name: region
variableMeasured.description: Pre-defined spatial sampling strata in the Bering Sea. Regions 1-6 correspond with EBS BSIERP regions, Regions 7-9 correspond with NBS BSIERP regions.

variableMeasured.name: lme
variableMeasured.description: Large marine ecosystem: EBS=eastern Bering Sea, NBS=northern Bering Sea
